what: Spec-gate reasoning-budget sweep, the companion to the gap-audit sweep
gate: spec (2 lanes: fidelity, testability) judging a PRD against the interview log it came from

docs.real-passed: agents/prd/implement-check/prd.md (279 lines) against its own qa-log, a PRD whose spec gate PASSed in production

conclusion: high is right for spec too, and the case against xhigh is stronger here than for gap-audit: on the real PRD xhigh took 2.1x the wall time of high and returned FEWER findings (3.3 vs 4.0), where gap-audit at least bought a slight gain (6.3 vs 5.7). medium collapses on the real document (1.0 findings) exactly as it did for gap-audit.
instrumentWarning: The planted-mine PRD detects 9 of 9 mines at every effort from medium to xhigh, so like the gap-audit mine fixture it cannot rank budgets - scored alone it always nominates the cheapest option. Both gates now show this. Budget decisions must be made on a real document.
alsoObserved: The two gates have different severity temperaments: spec emitted 3 P0 findings across 3 runs of the real PRD, gap-audit emitted 1 across 3 runs of its real log.

findings.missing: R6와 AC6가 사용자가 명시적으로 기각한 자동 병합을 요구하고, 충돌 시 두 버전 비교 및 수동 해결 결정을 누락했다.
R13이 권한 경계를 기록하지만 사용자가 정한 ‘보안 요건 강화 시 재검토’ 조건을 보존하지 않았다.
D-19의 이메일/슬랙 알림 non-goal은 기록했지만 ‘관리자 다수 요청 시 재검토’ 조건이 누락됐다.
AC3 uses the vague acceptance language "적절히 빠르게" and "사용자가 불편을 느끼지 않는다", so it has no observable pass condition.
R8 has no acceptance criterion or required verification covering tag-name matching and automatic creation of missing tags.
V3 does not verify R2's five-minute background schedule, relative last-sync display, or header-banner failure behavior; it only states that the manual flow works.

R6 and AC6 require automatic merging to the latest version, directly contradicting the user's explicit rejection of auto-merge and the required conflict-badge, side-by-side review, and manual-resolution flow.
The PRD omits D18's revisit condition that the permission policy should be reconsidered if security requirements become stricter.

The PRD does not represent D19's decision that repeated-failure notifications are limited to a header banner, with email and Slack explicitly excluded and revisited only after multiple administrator requests.

R6/AC6 require automatic conflict merging, while the recorded user decision explicitly rejects auto-merge and requires manual resolution, so the expected behavior and its verification outcome contradict each other.
AC3 defines completion speed only as 'appropriately fast' and 'not inconvenient', leaving the acceptance outcome untestable.
R8 has no verification entry that explicitly checks name-based tag matching and automatic creation of missing tags.
V1's deletion pass intent does not explicitly verify trash movement, 30-day retention, and permanent deletion after retention expiry required by R5/AC5.
The PRD marks approval for a one-document list-format bootstrap exception, but the interview approved the AC table contract and contains no user approval for this exception.
The PRD omits the resolved counter lifecycle rule that counters freeze while parked and persist across session restarts.

The PRD does not explicitly preserve D-30's side-effect boundary: only working-tree writes and temporary files are allowed, while network or system-changing commands must be rejected at bind time without new secret delivery.
R7/AC15 and V3 conflict on whether a task containing only a machine+gate:human AC may close without green or parked, so the expected observable close result is undefined.
Human verification condition 1 permits either reaching finalize or receiving an undefined 'honest rejection', allowing an implementation failure to pass without a specified expected terminal state.
V3 does not explicitly verify R12's required preservation of artifact hash fixation and retention when adding AC binding.
R6와 AC6가 사용자가 명시적으로 기각한 자동 병합을 요구하며, 충돌 배지·양쪽 버전 비교·수동 해결·해결 전 동기화 제외를 누락했다.
D-18의 ‘보안 요건 강화 시 재검토’ 조건이 R13에 반영되지 않았다.
D-19의 실패 안내를 목록 헤더 배너로만 제공한다는 결정과 ‘관리자 다수 요청 시 재검토’ 조건이 누락되었다.
R6/AC6 requires automatic merge while the interview explicitly rejects auto-merge and the UX scenario requires manual conflict resolution, so there is no single observable pass oracle.
AC3 uses the non-testable acceptance language “적절히 빠르게” and “사용자가 불편을 느끼지 않는다.”
R8 has no required verification entry or explicit disposition for tag-name matching and automatic tag creation.

Several verification pass intents describe tests being “fixed” or “regression protected” without observable assertions for covered sub-behaviors such as the five-minute trigger, external_id/title conversion, large-note badge recovery, and sync_events UI non-exposure.
The PRD marks the checklist as human-approved, but the cited quote does not explicitly approve the unapproved AC-list/bootstrap exception, and section 4.2 says that approval is still required.
The PRD commits to local delivery with direct commits to main and no PR request, but this decision is absent from the interview log and lacks cited repository evidence.

The resolved trust boundary is incomplete: the PRD omits the explicit limits to working-tree or temporary writes, bind-time rejection of network or system-changing commands, and no-new-secrets environment policy.
R6 and AC6 directly contradict D-12 by requiring automatic merging, while the interview explicitly rejected auto-merge and requires conflict badges with side-by-side manual resolution.
R13 preserves the permission-loss behavior but omits D-18's revisit condition that the policy must be reconsidered if security requirements are strengthened.
The PRD does not represent D-19's resolved failure-notification behavior that failures are shown only as a list-header banner, despite excluding email and Slack.
R6, AC6, and V1 require automatic merging despite the recorded user decision explicitly rejecting auto-merge in favor of manual conflict resolution.
AC3 uses the unmeasurable acceptance language “적절히 빠르게” and “사용자가 불편을 느끼지 않는다,” so it has no objective pass condition.
R8’s tag name matching and automatic tag creation has no explicit required verification or disposition in the verification contract.
D-23/D-30의 명시적 부작용 경계인 워킹트리 내부 쓰기·임시 파일만 허용하고 네트워크·시스템 변경 명령은 바인딩 단계에서 fail-closed로 거부한다는 결정이 PRD에 구체적으로 반영되지 않았다.

R6 and AC6 directly contradict D-12 by requiring automatic merging into one latest version while omitting the required conflict badge, side-by-side comparison, manual resolution, and exclusion until resolved.
R13 captures D-18's permission behavior but omits its revisit condition that stronger security requirements may reopen the policy.
The PRD omits D-19's positive decision that failures surface only through a list-header banner and its revisit condition of multiple administrator requests.
R6와 AC6가 사용자가 명시적으로 거부한 자동 병합을 요구하며, 수동 충돌 해결 UX 시나리오와 정면으로 충돌한다.
AC3의 '적절히 빠르게'와 '사용자가 불편을 느끼지 않는다'는 관찰 가능한 완료 기준이 아니다.
R8의 태그 이름 매칭 및 상대편 태그 자동 생성에 대한 Required Agent Verification 또는 명시적 disposition이 없다.
PRD가 목록형 AC를 허용하는 bootstrap 예외를 사용자 승인에 포함했다고 주장하지만, 인터뷰 로그에는 이 예외에 대한 명시적 승인이나 결정이 없다.
D-30과 D-35의 신뢰 경계인 워킹트리·임시 파일만 허용, 네트워크·시스템 변경 명령 거부, 기존 셸 환경·시크릿 전달 유지가 PRD에 구체적으로 명시되지 않았다.
R12의 검증 의도는 AC 등록과 기존 V 경로 회귀만 확인하며, 해시 고정·보존과 AC 등록 시 해당 메커니즘의 공존을 관찰 가능한 결과로 검증하지 않는다.
Human Verification 1번은 finalize 도달과 '정직한 거부'를 모두 통과로 허용하지만 어떤 상태가 기대 결과인지와 거부가 정직한지의 판정 기준이 정의되지 않았다.
R6 and AC6 directly contradict D-12 by requiring automatic latest-version merging instead of a conflict badge, side-by-side review, and manual resolution with synchronization paused until resolution.
The PRD omits D-18's revisit condition that the permission policy should be reconsidered if security requirements become stricter.
The PRD omits D-19's failure-notification policy: failures must use only a list-header banner, with email and Slack excluded and reconsideration triggered by multiple administrator requests.
R6와 AC6은 자동 병합을 요구하지만, 인터뷰 결정 D-12는 자동 병합을 명시적으로 거부하고 충돌 배지와 수동 해결을 요구한다.
AC3의 '적절히 빠르게'와 '사용자가 불편을 느끼지 않는다'는 측정 가능한 관찰 기준이 없어 합격 여부를 판정할 수 없다.
R8의 태그 이름 매칭 및 상대편에 없는 태그 자동 생성에 대한 필수 검증이 Verification Contract에 없다.

The PRD marks the unapproved bootstrap exception to D-12's required AC-table format as approved, although the interview only approved the decision/evidence columns and contains no consent for exempting this PRD.

The PRD does not preserve D-10's selected initial fingerprint behavior: exit code plus matched failure-signature lines, last-30-lines fallback, and aggressive normalization including numeric literals.

V2/V3 do not explicitly require observable assertions for several core guard and transition outcomes they claim to cover, including decision-point state/status idempotence, parked-check rejection, resume to pending with counter reset while preserving a closed task, and unbound or non-green machine close rejection with the blocking AC.

Human Verification item 1 permits either reaching finalize or receiving an unspecified 'honest rejection', so an unexpected failure could satisfy the required check without proving a successful end-to-end run.
R6 and AC6 directly contradict D-12 by requiring automatic merging instead of conflict badges, side-by-side review, and manual resolution.
The PRD omits D-19's resolved failure-notification behavior that failures are shown only as a list-header banner, with email and Slack explicitly excluded and revisit conditions preserved.
R13 represents D-18's permission boundary but omits its revisit condition that the policy should be reconsidered if security requirements become stricter.
AC3 defines completion speed and user discomfort subjectively, so it has no objective pass/fail condition.
R8 requires tag-name matching and automatic tag creation, but no required verification has a pass intent that explicitly exercises either behavior.
V3 covers R2 only through the manual flow, leaving the five-minute scheduler and relative last-sync timestamp without an explicit observable verification intent.
PRD가 D-10의 실패 클래스 계산 방식인 시그니처 라인 추출과 시그니처가 없을 때 마지막 30줄 fallback을 명시하지 않아 구현자가 다른 지문 범위를 선택할 수 있다.
PRD가 D-30의 명시적 side-effect 경계인 워킹트리·임시 파일 쓰기만 허용하고 네트워크·시스템 변경 명령은 바인딩 시 fail-closed로 거부한다는 정책을 충분히 보존하지 않는다.

R6 contradicts D-12 by specifying automatic merging to the latest state, while the interview explicitly rejects auto-merge and requires a conflict badge, side-by-side comparison, and manual resolution with syncing paused until resolved.

D-19's approved failure-notification policy is absent: failures must appear only as a header banner, with email and Slack notifications excluded and reconsidered only after multiple administrator requests.
R13 captures D-18's current permission behavior but omits the explicit revisit condition that it may be reconsidered if security requirements become stricter.
R6, AC6, and V1 require automatic conflict merging, directly contradicting the user's recorded decision to prohibit auto-merge and require manual conflict resolution with a conflict badge.
AC3 uses vague, non-observable acceptance language ('적절히 빠르게' and '사용자가 불편을 느끼지 않는다').
R8 has no required verification covering name-based tag matching and automatic creation of missing tags.

The required verification intents do not explicitly cover the 30-day soft-delete retention and permanent deletion in R5, or archive release re-inclusion and prohibition of counterpart archive representations in R10.
The PRD introduces a bootstrap exception allowing list-style AC syntax instead of the interview's required AC table format, without an explicit user decision approving that exception.
The D-10 fingerprint decision is underspecified: the PRD does not preserve signature-line extraction, last-30-line fallback, exit-code inclusion, or the complete aggressive-normalization rule.
R6는 사용자가 명시적으로 기각한 자동 병합을 요구하며, 충돌 배지·양 버전 비교·수동 해결·해결 전 동기화 제외를 누락했다.
R4가 일반 멤버에게 API 키 존재 여부를 보여준다는 보안 정책을 사용자 결정으로 기록하지 않은 채 추가했다.
D18의 보안 요건 강화 시 재검토 조건이 PRD에 보존되지 않았다.
D19의 실패 안내를 목록 헤더 배너로만 제공한다는 동작과 관리자 다수 요청 시 재검토 조건이 요구사항에 없다.
R6와 AC6의 자동 병합 요구가 사용자가 명시적으로 기각한 결정(D-12)과 정면으로 충돌한다.
AC3의 ‘적절히 빠르게’와 ‘사용자가 불편을 느끼지 않는다’는 측정 가능한 완료 조건이 없어 테스트 판정이 불가능하다.
R8의 태그 이름 매칭 및 상대편 태그 자동 생성에 대응하는 acceptance criterion이나 Required Agent Verification이 없다.
PRD는 인터뷰에서 승인되지 않은 AC 표 형식의 bootstrap 예외를 승인된 체크리스트로 취급하지만, 로그가 승인한 것은 판정 컬럼 필수 규칙이며 이 예외에 대한 사용자 승인은 없다.
D-10의 핵심 지문 정책인 exit code 포함, FAIL/error/panic/assert 시그니처 라인 추출과 마지막 30줄 fallback, ANSI·16진 주소 정규화가 PRD의 요구사항과 AC에 완전히 반영되지 않았다.
PRD의 `워킹트리 내 쓰기만 허용`은 D-30의 워킹트리 쓰기와 임시 파일 허용 범위를 좁히며, D-35의 부사수 셸과 동일한 환경 사용 및 신규 시크릿 전달 금지 결정도 명시하지 않는다.
